wiki.summary: “Plot Twist” was first previewed during Drake’s birthday party in Houston back in 2024, as well as by Octavian during a DJ set later that same year. He previewed the song again during his show in February 2026. Allegedly, Drake’s second verse on the song was remade in 2025. By “Plot Twist”, Drake potentially signals a shift from a defensive stance to an offensive one, suggesting that his supposed downfall was merely a setup for a massive comeback. Read more on Last.fm.
